verdict.rationale: Circle documents that qualified businesses can use a Circle Mint account to convert USD to and from USDC at no extra cost (circle-docs-13), with 1:1 redeemability for USDC and EURC (circle-docs-27, circle-docs-28). StableFX also exposes tradable quotes between currencies (circle-docs-43). However, the pack contains no Mint API or dashboard documentation for internal fiat↔stablecoin transfers or rebalancing; the CPN payouts and Gateway balances cover different flows. Missing for 10: documented Mint/account API endpoints for fiat↔USDC conversion and internal transfers, dashboard rebalancing workflow, end-to-end walkthrough, independent or hands-on corroboration.
